step_key.description: The step to mark as completed (must match a valid step_key).

step.description: The step after being marked complete.

hr.setup.v1.SetupWizardStepPayload.description: SetupWizardStepPayload is a single step in the HR setup wizard.

completed_at.description: Unix timestamp when this step was completed; absent if not yet completed.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this step record was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the setup step record.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this step belongs to.

step_key.description: Which setup step this represents (company_profile | work_schedule | leave_policy | org_structure | locations | roles_permissions | payroll | notifications | employees).

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this step record was last updated.
